name: United International Trading Company W.L.L
note: UITC (Doha-HQ'd, est. 1983) owns SunLife Pharmacy, a 20+ branch Qatar retail pharmacy chain with a live transactional store at sunlife.qa (cart, medicines/health/beauty, 24/7 delivery). Retail pharmacy is the explicit Gate 2 exception; substantial dedicated retail arm, not thin.

name: Wellcare Pharmacy Qatar
note: 90+ branch Qatar retail pharmacy chain with a real online pharmacy (wellcareonline.com, 6000+ products, 1-hour delivery) and its own app. Substantial retail-pharmacy arm qualifies under the Gate 2 exception; Qatar-based.

name: alrifaisaudi
note: Operated by Gulf Trading Holding Company, genuinely Riyadh-HQ'd (D&B/SaudiYP), running the Al Rifai franchise with ~120 KSA outlets since 1998 -- the Cenomi/Jarir franchise-operator pattern that passes Gate 1. Nuts/coffee is high-repeat F&B; live branded store.

name: cityflowerretail
note: City Flower (Fleeriya Group, first store Riyadh 2004) runs 13-25 department stores plus hypermarkets across KSA with a broad general-merchandise range and a live app/site. Approved category, Saudi-HQ'd, clear multi-store scale.

name: carly
note: Automotive category is excluded, but the Gate 5b app rescue re-confirms independently: ~80,000 downloads on AppBrain, updated Jan 2026 with ~4.9k installs/month (active, not stale), developer One Sky (Riyadh). Above the 50k threshold, so it qualifies via the app path.

name: مخابز وحلويات نعمه
note: Neamah Bakery & Sweets runs 5+ branches across Jeddah and Mecca with its own branded online ordering (neamah.my.taker.io) plus HungerStation/TheChefz. Bakery is approved high-repeat F&B with genuine Saudi multi-branch scale and a real digital channel.

name: sondos
note: sondos.com is a tissue manufacturer's (Al Faris Industrial Group) own-brand D2C webshop selling only its own factory output across 3 categories (tissues, hand soap, plastics); no physical retail stores of its own. Thin storefront bolted onto an industrial business -- the Radwa fail pattern, not the Lazurde/Union retail-network pass.

name: Sleep High
note: Fundamentally a mattress manufacturer/retailer since 1963; catalog is dominated by mattresses/beds/recliners (long-replacement durables) with only modest linen/towel/pillow accessory lines. Mattress-centric identity triggers the Gate 3 concern; the prior 'broad bedding range' framing is overstated, leaving genuine ambiguity rather than a clean Yes.

name: AAW Pharma & Medical
note: AAW (Ali Abdulwahab Al Mutawa, Kuwait) operates Al Mutawa Pharmacies, a 30+ branch Kuwait retail pharmacy chain (almutawaph.com.kw) with a live iOS/Android e-commerce app and delivery. Retail pharmacy is the Gate 2 exception; Kuwait is in-scope. Should be mapped/deduped to the Al Mutawa Pharmacies entity.

name: RojoCoral Boutique | Children's Fashion & Accessories
note: rojocoral.com is a live Salla store (SAR) but a small online-only, made-to-order (reserve-via-WhatsApp) boutique selling exclusively children's special-occasion dresses; modest catalog below the ~50-SKU substantiality floor, no physical store, and a narrow low-repeat occasion-wear category.

name: SWAJ | سواج
note: Arabic name matches swag.sa exactly; it is a live (403 = bot-protected per Gate 4, not dead) Saudi ready-to-wear unisex streetwear brand (tees/hoodies/shirts/pants/shorts/sets) with Kingdom-wide shipping. Approved multi-item fashion category, Saudi-based; exact SKU count not countable behind bot-protection but geography and category are solid.

name: الغانم للأجهزة الكهربائية AL-GHANIM STORE
note: Verified via Arabic sources as a DISTINCT Saudi company (not Kuwait's Alghanim, which retails as Xcite): founded 2001 in Sakaka/Al-Jouf, now 19 branches across Al-Jouf/Northern Borders/Tabuk/Riyadh, Saudi LinkedIn and +966 contact. Live SAR appliance/electronics e-commerce; approved category, Saudi HQ, real scale.

name: Alif Stores
note: Qatar's biggest bookstore/lifestyle retailer (founded 2019, Doha): alifstores.com carries 25,000+ products (books/electronics/toys/stationery), a 4,000 sqm Doha flagship plus a Place Vendome store, and iOS/Android apps. Approved category, Qatar HQ, very large scale.

name: SAVECO Online Hypermarket
note: Kuwait-HQ'd hypermarket chain (Al-Qatami Group, est. 2013) with multiple physical stores, a live own site (saveco.com) and its own 'Saveco Online Store' app plus Talabat. Grocery/hypermarket is approved and Kuwait is in-scope. Data note: mis-tagged 'Saudi Arabia' -- the entity is Kuwait (Saudi is only a future expansion plan).
